news.title: DSM Fresh Foods Reportedly in Talks to Acquire Majority Stake in GM Foods
news.body: Zappfresh, owned by DSM Fresh Foods Limited (BSE:544568) is in talks to acquire a majority stake in Sonipat-based GM Foods in Haryana, which makes ready-cook breakfast staples, spices and dessert mixes, people directly aware of the development said. The potential deal, if it goes through, is being discussed at a valuation of close to INR 200 million and will add to Zappfresh's recent foray in the frozen vegetarian snacks segment under new label Meevaa Foods, as it looks to step up competition against players such as breakfast mixes brand MTR and DS Foods-owned Catch spices, one of the executives said.

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price decline to ₹83.10, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 13.6x. Average trailing P/E is 23x in the Consumer Retailing industry in India.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Independent Director Achal Kapoor was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
